explain.meaning: A lower price for people who hold a membership.

services.name: Private Lessons
services.desc: Discounts are available for Swallow Hill Music members. Tuition Assistance is also available. Students may cancel a private lesson at least 24 hours before the lesson to reschedule or receive an account credit. No-shows and cancellations within 24 hours will not receive a refund or credit. Click on your chosen instrument to be taken to our online course catalog, Configio, where you’ll see the teachers currently available for private music lessons on that instrument, in-person in Denver or online. services.name: summer camps
services.desc: At House of Rock, young singers, guitarist, bassists, drummers, and keyboard/piano players will dive into the world of rock music. They’ll gain the hands-on skills to jam with other musicians, all guided by expert instructors. Each week of camp wraps up with an epic stage performance complete with sound system, sound engineer, and lights. Beginner rockers will learn and perform eight songs from different artists, eras, and genres. For campers with some experience who’ve played in a band before and are ready for the next
